question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms
  FROM Track
),
thresholds AS (
  SELECT 
    min_ms,
    avg_ms,
    max_ms,
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2 as midpoint1,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2 as midpoint2
  FROM stats
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Name,
    t.Milliseconds,
    (t.Milliseconds * 1.0 / 60000) as duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= h.midpoint1 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= h.midpoint2 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN thresholds h
),
revenue_by_track AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.TrackId,
    ct.category,
    ct.duration_minutes,
    COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) as track_revenue
  FROM classified ct
  LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON ct.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY ct.TrackId, ct.category, ct.duration_minutes
)
SELECT 
  category,
  MIN(duration_minutes) as min_duration,
  MAX(duration_minutes) as max_duration,
  SUM(track_revenue) as total_revenue
FROM revenue_by_track
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
